description: Step 9 of docs/the-delivery-loop.md: a trunk accepted, then published and released. The mandate is one JSON object naming the repo and the version, with base and forge_repo optional; an unsaid base is the trunk the repository declares. The candidate is the commit the tree's trunk branch carries, clean, and the remote trunk must be its ancestor. The notes are the CHANGELOG.md section for the version at that commit; with no such section the run stops before anything is built. Before anything leaves, the policy is read from the trusted trunk, `ask` hands the release to a person, and the publication gate runs on what the candidate would publish. `sailor release sailor --no-push --candidate` then builds a detached checkout of exactly that commit and installs it, pushing nothing. The stamp must name the candidate, and bin/sailor must match the sha256 the release recorded. A person walks the acceptance journey on that binary, bound to its commit and digest, whatever the policy says. Only after a green journey are the gate and the policy read again, the installed digest checked unchanged, and the remote trunk checked unmoved. The flow then pushes the trunk itself, with the tree's own account and upstream, and checks that the remote carries the candidate. The notes pass the text gate, the tag is pushed, and the run completes only when the host reports a published, non-draft release for that tag. Every forge call runs as the account in sailor.forgeAs. What this flow defends against: a different sailor found on PATH, an installed binary that does not match the candidate, a delivery policy that is missing, is not readable as JSON, or whose merge, push and release fields are not auto or ask, and a remote that cannot be read or has moved. What it does not defend against: whoever can already write to the directory of the sailor in service can replace that binary between its sha256 check and its execution; and whoever closes a handed step, such as authorize_release or journey, does it with the sailor on their own PATH.

with.command:
set -eu
common=$(cd "$REPO" && cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" && pwd)
outgoing="$common/sailor/outgoing"
mkdir -p "$outgoing"
file="$outgoing/release-notes-$VERSION.md"
git -C "$REPO" show "$CANDIDATE:CHANGELOG.md" > "$outgoing/changelog-$VERSION.md" 2>/dev/null || { echo "the candidate carries no CHANGELOG.md: the release stops" >&2; exit 1; }
VERSION="$VERSION" FILE="$file" python3 -c "$NOTES_PROGRAM" "$outgoing/changelog-$VERSION.md"

env.NOTES_PROGRAM:
import json, os, re, sys
text = open(sys.argv[1]).read()
version = os.environ["VERSION"]
heading = re.compile(r"^## \[?v?" + re.escape(version) + r"\]?(\s.*)?$")
lines = text.splitlines()
start = next((i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if heading.match(line)), None)
if start is None:
    sys.exit("CHANGELOG.md has no section for %s: the release stops" % version)
end = next((i for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)) if lines[i].startswith("## ")), len(lines))
notes = "\n".join(lines[start + 1:end]).strip()
if not notes:
    sys.exit("the CHANGELOG.md section for %s is empty: the release stops" % version)
open(os.environ["FILE"], "w").write(notes + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"notes_file": os.environ["FILE"]}))

$join: The delivery policy read from the trusted trunk (commit

) asks a person before this flow may build and install the candidate, walk the journey on it, push the trunk, tag it and publish the release. Approve with an output file holding {"authorized": true}, or reject with the reason.

options.label: authorize
options.facts: every check before this step passed on the recorded commit

options.label: refuse
options.facts: nothing outward has happened yet; the run stops here

$join: Walk docs/acceptance-journey.md on the binary this run just installed, the file

). Run every command of the journey with that exact path, never the sailor your PATH finds first and never an older one: the digest belongs to that file alone. Nothing has been pushed yet. Record the walk outside this tree until the release is published. Approve with an output file holding {"commit": the commit above, "binary_sha256": the digest above, "green": true} only when every step is green; reject with the red steps otherwise, and nothing is published. This step runs whatever the release policy says.

options.label: green
options.facts: every step of the journey met its expectation on the candidate

options.label: red
options.facts: a red step stops the release, whatever the suite said, and the trunk is never pushed

with.command:
set -eu
printf '%s' "$WALK" | CANDIDATE="$CANDIDATE" DIGEST="$DIGEST" python3 -c '
import json, os, sys
walk = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
if not isinstance(walk, dict) or walk.get("commit") != os.environ["CANDIDATE"]:
    sys.exit("the journey was not walked on the candidate %s" % os.environ["CANDIDATE"])
if walk.get("binary_sha256") != os.environ["DIGEST"]:
    sys.exit("the journey was not walked on the binary with sha256 %s" % os.environ["DIGEST"])
if walk.get("green") is not True:
    sys.exit("the journey is not green")
print(json.dumps({"commit": walk["commit"], "binary_sha256": walk["binary_sha256"], "green": True}))
'
